name: Revisioned SelectionArea participant reconciliation

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: headed WASM/WebGPU SelectionArea fixture at DPR 1 and DPR 2
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Revisioned SelectionArea participant reconciliation

Replace per-frame participant ID vectors and temporary `HashSet`s with an area-owned revisioned position map. Reconcile registration identity and order from the next traversal in one pass, retaining only active participants without participant-sized temporary sets.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement plan

Measure the existing many-participant SelectionArea fixture with headed WASM/WebGPU at DPR 1 and DPR 2 using 35 repetitions per project and discard five warmups. Compare p50 and p95 input-to-published-frame durations, then run the focused fixture after the change.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected outcome

Unchanged SelectionArea frames avoid temporary ID and `HashSet` allocations while preserving participant order, nested and disabled scopes, and selection behavior. Reject on a focused fixture failure, screenshot regression, or a p95 regression above five percent.

measurements.target: headed WASM/WebGPU SelectionArea fixture; 35 repetitions per DPR with five warmups discarded

reportMarkdown:
## Revisioned SelectionArea participant reconciliation

Rejected and reverted. The candidate replaced temporary participant ID vectors and `HashSet`s with a revisioned area-owned position map. The focused SelectionArea fixture rendered correctly and passed its normal DPR 1/DPR 2 smoke run, but its repeated DPR 1 p95 input-to-published-frame duration regressed from 95.91 ms to 105.40 ms (9.9%). That exceeds the experiment's five-percent limit.

The first baseline pass had one unrelated DPR 2 browser closure during screenshot capture; a narrow DPR 2 retry passed. The accepted 70-run post-change measurement completed with no failures. The source was returned exactly to its checkpoint implementation before recording this result.

Decision: do not retain the map. A later experiment must improve dormant reconciliation without introducing a map-maintenance cost on every participant traversal.
